[Aggregator] Phase A — Poll
Source: BRD + Kear Persistance_Table
SELECT * FROM RDH_PERSISTENCE
WHERE MIFID_STATUS='PENDING' AND REGIME='MIFID'
SET MIFID_STATUS='READING' (lock).
Fires before each Trax batch window.

→ STOP — No Report

CORRECTION_DEAD sets MIFID_Ignore. No ARM. STOP.

div.div:
[Component] Stage 6 — Field Enrichment
Source: BRD §6 (IDM/EDM) · BRD §7 (MIC)
Fires after Phase D. PF events only.
NPF events SKIP Stage 6 entirely.
Re-derives IDM (F57) — BRD §6.
Re-derives EDM (F59) — BRD §6.
Day 1: IDM = EDM = Trader.
Day 2 (legal pending): Sales = EDM.
Re-derives MIC (F36) — BRD §7.
Soft-link: carry MIC + TVTI if blank.
All carry-over in JSON DSL layer.
UPDATE RDH_PERSISTENCE: IDM · EDM · MIC.

OUT OF SCOPE
Reads PERSISTENCE. Suppresses IS_NRPT=Y.
Builds ARM CSV. Sends to Trax: 07:30+18:00 AEST.

div.div: KEY RULES (Stage 2 — Kear call confirmed) 1. Every Kafka event creates a NEW ROW in BOTH tables (incl. NPF, replay) — Kear confirmed. 2. Replay: new row written with REPLAY_FLAG=Y, same MIFID_LINK_ID, skip Steps 1.0–2.0. 3. NPF: new row, same MIFID_LINK_ID + TRN carried. Persistence row inserted with carry-forward values. 4. PF/NRPT: new MIFID_LINK_ID, new TRN, new Persistence row. 5. ROOT_LINK_ID = first event MIFID_LINK_ID — new column — Kear confirmed for audit trail + sequencing. 6. MIFID_ACTION = NULL after Stage 2. 7. One vs multiple linkage tables (regime-specific): ⚠ open action on Kear (A1).

div.div:
[Aggregator] Phase C — Delta Check
Source: BRD 5.1 + Kear DELTA_WF_FINAL + Kear design call
CONFIRMED (Kear call):
Step 1: Compare ALL reporting fields — always run for both YF and YE.
Both YF and YE perform the same full field comparison.
Compare against: MIFID_REPORTING_TABLE via TRN lookup.
Check A: Quantity delta (INT_RPT_QTY vs CURRENT_QTY).
Check B: All reporting fields vs previous version.
Step 2: DELTA_TYPE decides what to DO with the result — not which fields to compare.
DELTA_TYPE sourced from LCE enrichment (MX3 Events Sheet Col Y) — NOT a DB column.

Written by: Stage 2 (ALL events — every Kafka event
creates a new row, including NPF and replay).
Purpose: cache of carried-forward ARM-reportable field
values — enriched via MXML layer (not direct DB lookup).
Phase A reads PENDING. Phase C reads current values.
Phase D sets MIFID_ACTION. Stage 6 updates IDM/EDM/MIC.
NOT used as delta comparison source — delta
comparison is done against MIFID_REPORTING_TABLE.
⚠ DELTA_TYPE is NOT a column here (LCE enrichment only)

div.span:
Kear confirmed: this IS the outbound table — stores all
eligible trades sent or to-be-sent for ARM batch processing.
Phase C delta comparison source — lookup by TRN.
If TRN not found → brand new (no delta needed).
If TRN found → compare vs latest reported version.
Phase D reads + writes — insert-only, new record per event.
Statuses: PENDING, SENT, OBSOLETE, FAIL.

div.div:
KEY DESIGN DECISIONS + RULES — Updated from Kear call + DELTA_WF_FINAL + EXGESTER_WF_FINAL
Stage 2: 1. Every event (PF, NPF, NRPT, Replay) inserts new row in BOTH RDH_TRADE_LINEAGE and RDH_PERSISTENCE — no exceptions. 2. NPF: carry same MIFID_LINK_ID, new row, update event label + timestamp. 3. Replay: new row in both tables with REPLAY_FLAG=Y + same LINK_ID. 4. ROOT_LINK_ID: new column in LINEAGE = MIFID_LINK_ID of very first event in lifecycle — used for full audit trail + sequencing. 5. MIFID_ACTION = NULL after Stage 2. Stage 3 sets. Stage 3 Phase C: 6. Delta comparison is against MIFID_REPORTING_TABLE (outbound) using TRN as lookup key — NOT against PERSISTENCE. 7. Full delta (YF) AND Economic delta (YE) BOTH compare ALL reporting fields — same comparison process. 8. DELTA_TYPE decides what to DO with the result: YF = report out if ANY field changed; YE = report if economic field changed, suppress if only non-economic changed. DELTA_TYPE is NOT about which fields to compare — it is about how to act on the result. 9. Economic vs non-economic tags held in a static rules/reference table. 10. Persistence field enrichment happens in MXML layer — not in JSON DSL layer. Architecture: 11. MIFID_REPORTING_TABLE is the single outbound table. Enriched field values flow through MXML layer into this table. ⚠ Open actions: A1 (one vs multiple linkage tables — Kear), A7 (economic field list — Kear+Den), A9 (JSON table design — Sujeet+Pran+Vishali).

div.span:
Step 1: ALWAYS compare ALL fields
(same process for YF and YE).
Step 2: DELTA_TYPE decides outcome:
YF = any field changed → report out
YE = economic field changed → report
only non-economic → suppress
N = skip comparison entirely
DELTA_TYPE is NOT about WHICH fields
to compare — it is about WHAT TO DO
with the comparison result.

div.div:
→ Quantity Delta Found
Source: Kear DELTA_WF_FINAL
REPL, no prior DECR_INCR flag:
Report CURRENT quantity as-is.
REPL, existing DECR_INCR flag:
Continue reporting DELTA_QTY.
NEWT (amendment):
Report change-in-quantity with
DECR/INCR flag set.

div.div:
→ Field Delta Found
Source: BRD 5.1 + Den §3+§4 + Kear call
If economic field changed (tagged Y in rules table):
MIFID_ACTION = REPL → Phase D
If ONLY non-economic field changed (tagged N):
MIFID_ACTION = SUPPRESS → STOP (YE only)
12 economic fields: F7,F16,F28,F33,F36,F41,F57,F59,
PriceCCY,Qty,NotionalAmt,NotionalCCY.
⚠ Full list pending Kear confirmation

div.span:
Decision rule: If ANY field changed
(economic OR non-economic) → report out.
No suppression based on field type.
MIFID_ACTION = REPL (or NEWT if first).
